purpose: Owner-shaped end-to-end journeys through the Studio UI, written as intents so the measured matrix reports the pipeline rather than the selectors. Executed by tests/studio_use_cases.py.

cases.goal: Turn a written character brief into a ready-to-run illustration recipe without generating anything by accident.
cases.success_condition: A recipe is chosen, the brief wording is in the recipe, and the run control reports ready while zero generation requests have been sent.

steps.intent: open the overview and see where a new piece of work starts
steps.expect: the overview names a starting point for making something

steps.intent: move to the place where recipes are chosen
steps.expect: the recipe workspace opens with a list of recipes

steps.intent: search for a recipe by the kind of picture wanted, an anime character portrait
steps.expect: the recipe list narrows to matching recipes

steps.intent: choose an illustration recipe from the narrowed list
steps.expect: a recipe is selected and its controls appear

steps.intent: describe the character in the brief's own words
steps.expect: the description is held by the recipe

steps.intent: state what the picture must avoid
steps.expect: the avoid wording is held by the recipe

steps.intent: check the recipe reports itself ready to run, without running it
steps.expect: the run control is enabled and nothing has been submitted

cases.goal: Edit an existing character picture with one reference, after first trying it on a recipe that cannot take a reference at all.
cases.success_condition: The wrong turn is recorded with whatever the screen said about it, then a one-reference recipe holds an attached source and reports ready.

steps.intent: choose a text-only illustration recipe as the starting point
steps.expect: a recipe with no reference slot is selected

steps.intent: try to bring a saved picture into that text-only recipe
steps.expect: the screen explains that this recipe cannot take a reference

steps.intent: read whatever the screen now says about sources for this recipe
steps.expect: an explanation names the missing reference slot

steps.intent: search for a recipe that accepts a reference image
steps.expect: the recipe list narrows to reference-edit recipes

steps.intent: choose the recipe that takes one reference picture
steps.expect: a recipe with a reference slot is selected

steps.intent: pull a saved character picture from the library into the reference slot
steps.expect: the picture is attached as the source and the original stays in the library

steps.intent: write what changes and what must stay the same
steps.expect: both the change and the invariants are held by the recipe

steps.intent: check the edit reports itself ready to run
steps.expect: the run control is enabled and nothing has been submitted

cases.goal: Preserve a character's identity while changing pose and style by giving three references explicit roles.
cases.success_condition: Three reference slots each hold a picture with a distinct role, and the recipe reports ready without submitting.

steps.intent: choose the reference-edit recipe that takes three pictures
steps.expect: three reference slots appear

steps.intent: say the first picture supplies the character's identity
steps.expect: the first slot records the identity role

steps.intent: attach a saved picture to the first slot
steps.expect: the first slot shows an attached picture

steps.intent: say the second picture supplies the pose
steps.expect: the second slot records the pose role

steps.intent: attach a saved picture to the second slot
steps.expect: the second slot shows an attached picture

steps.intent: say the third picture supplies the style
steps.expect: the third slot records the style role

steps.intent: attach a saved picture to the third slot
steps.expect: the third slot shows an attached picture

steps.intent: write what the identity picture must contribute
steps.expect: the contribution note is held for that slot

steps.intent: write the change and the invariants for the whole edit
steps.expect: the wording is held by the recipe

steps.intent: check the three-reference edit reports itself ready
steps.expect: the run control is enabled and nothing has been submitted

cases.goal: Ask one settings question about a chosen recipe and get a bounded comparison prepared, not started.
cases.success_condition: A comparison is prepared with an explicit setting, explicit candidate values and a run allowance, and it appears in Runs & review as prepared.

steps.intent: choose the recipe whose settings are in question
steps.expect: the recipe is selected with its controls

steps.intent: fix the brief so only one thing will change between candidates
steps.expect: the brief wording is held by the recipe

steps.intent: open the comparison planner from the recipe
steps.expect: a planner asks which single setting to vary

steps.intent: choose the guidance setting as the one thing to vary
steps.expect: the planner accepts that setting

steps.intent: read the candidate values the planner proposes
steps.expect: explicit candidate values are shown and editable

steps.intent: set how many graph runs this study may spend
steps.expect: the allowance is recorded

steps.intent: prepare the comparison without starting it
steps.expect: the planner prepares a study and says preparing is not starting

steps.intent: check the prepared study is listed in Runs & review
steps.expect: the study appears with a not-started state

cases.goal: Look at a finished comparison, decide which candidate is the keeper and record why.
cases.success_condition: A candidate is chosen with review notes, and the choice is recorded against the study.

steps.intent: open the place where finished runs are reviewed
steps.expect: the list of studies is shown

steps.intent: choose the comparison that is waiting for a decision
steps.expect: its candidates are shown

steps.intent: reveal which settings produced each candidate
steps.expect: each candidate's setting is labelled

steps.intent: open one candidate at full size to judge it
steps.expect: the candidate opens large enough to judge

steps.intent: write why this candidate is the keeper
steps.expect: the note is held against the study

steps.intent: keep the winning candidate
steps.expect: the choice is recorded as a creative preference

steps.intent: check the decision was recorded rather than started another run
steps.expect: the study records the choice and no generation was submitted

cases.goal: Take a kept picture out of the library and make it the reference for the next edit, carrying its source record.
cases.success_condition: A library picture is prepared as the source of a reference-edit recipe with its lineage intact, and the new recipe reports ready.

steps.intent: open the library of saved pictures
steps.expect: saved pictures are listed

steps.intent: open the kept picture to look at it
steps.expect: the picture's details open

steps.intent: start a continuation from this picture
steps.expect: a handoff asks where the picture should go next

steps.intent: choose a reference-edit recipe as the destination
steps.expect: the destination recipe is selected in the handoff

steps.intent: prepare the handoff without running it
steps.expect: the new recipe opens with the picture attached as its source

steps.intent: check the source picture and its origin travelled with it
steps.expect: the new recipe names the source picture it came from

steps.intent: write the new change for this edit
steps.expect: the wording is held by the new recipe

steps.intent: check the prepared edit reports itself ready
steps.expect: the run control is enabled and nothing has been submitted

cases.goal: Shape the wording for a character in Prompt Lab and hand the reviewed text to a recipe in Create.
cases.success_condition: Compiled wording reaches the recipe's brief field only after an explicit review and apply, with no generation.

steps.intent: open the place where wording is shaped before a run
steps.expect: a brief form with prompt profiles is shown

steps.intent: choose a prompt profile that matches making an image
steps.expect: the profile is selected

steps.intent: state the character brief in plain words
steps.expect: the brief is held

steps.intent: name the subject facet of the brief
steps.expect: the subject facet is held

steps.intent: compile the brief into proposed wording
steps.expect: proposed positive and negative wording is shown for review

steps.intent: send the reviewed wording over to Create
steps.expect: Create opens holding the transferred text, not yet applied

steps.intent: inspect the transferred wording before applying it
steps.expect: the text is previewed before it changes any recipe

steps.intent: apply the wording into the recipe
steps.expect: the recipe's brief field now holds the wording

cases.goal: Follow the guided 'Edit or preserve a character' path from the first stage to the last and end on a real control each time.
cases.success_condition: Every stage of the guided path is reached, each lands on a real control, and no generation is submitted.

steps.intent: open the page that offers guided paths
steps.expect: the guided paths page is shown

steps.intent: see which paths are offered and how many steps each one takes
steps.expect: the paths are listed with their step counts

steps.intent: start the path for editing or preserving a character
steps.expect: the first stage opens on a real control with its coaching text

steps.intent: advance to the stage about assigning what each picture contributes
steps.expect: the stage opens on the reference controls

steps.intent: advance to the stage about writing the change and the invariants
steps.expect: the stage opens on the brief field

steps.intent: advance to the stage about checking readiness before spending a run
steps.expect: the stage opens on the requirements panel

steps.intent: advance to the stage about generating only when you choose
steps.expect: the stage opens on the run control without pressing it

steps.intent: advance to the final stage about reviewing, keeping and reusing
steps.expect: the stage opens on the library

steps.intent: check the whole path never submitted a generation
steps.expect: no generation requests were sent

cases.goal: Build a small node workflow from the installed nodes, check it and get as far as preparing a run without executing one.
cases.success_condition: A graph is loaded and checked, the export becomes available, and the save/prepare controls are reached and recorded with whatever they report.

steps.intent: open the workflow builder
steps.expect: the builder is shown with its node catalog empty

steps.intent: see whether the node catalog has been loaded yet
steps.expect: the builder states that no node catalog is loaded

steps.intent: load the node catalog from the local runtime
steps.expect: the installed node count is reported

steps.intent: start from a registered recipe rather than an empty canvas
steps.expect: a graph with nodes is loaded into the builder

steps.intent: check the graph before doing anything with it
steps.expect: the check reports a result and no graph was run

steps.intent: confirm the checked graph can now be exported
steps.expect: the export control is available

steps.intent: save the workflow so it can be reused later
steps.expect: the save control reports what it needs

steps.intent: look for the control that prepares a run from a saved revision
steps.expect: either a prepare control is present or its absence is recorded

steps.intent: check nothing was submitted to the runtime
steps.expect: no run requests were sent

cases.goal: Pick a set of frames out of the library and get a native sprite export prepared for the engine.
cases.success_condition: Two or more image frames are selected, the native export dialog is configured, and an export is prepared and listed in Runs & review.

steps.intent: open the library of saved pictures
steps.expect: saved pictures are listed

steps.intent: narrow the library to still images only
steps.expect: only images remain listed

steps.intent: select the first frame for the export
steps.expect: the selection count shows one

steps.intent: select a second frame for the export
steps.expect: the selection count shows two

steps.intent: open the native export controls for the selected frames
steps.expect: an export dialog opens with the chosen frames

steps.intent: choose a sprite atlas as the export kind
steps.expect: the export kind is recorded

steps.intent: set how long each frame should show
steps.expect: the frame timing is recorded

steps.intent: prepare the export without starting it
steps.expect: the export is prepared and preparing is not starting

steps.intent: check the prepared export is listed in Runs & review
steps.expect: the export appears in the studies list

cases.goal: Take a recent output I like and paint it in another look, keeping the picture, without knowing which recipe does that.
cases.success_condition: The recent output is attached as the picture to restyle, the prepared wording (the finish, what to keep, the source description) is in the prompt, and the run control reports ready while zero generation requests have been sent.

steps.intent: continue with a recent output from the runs list
steps.expect: a dialog asks where the picture should go next

steps.intent: choose the route that borrows a look
steps.expect: the Restyle route is selected and lists a recipe that keeps the picture first

steps.intent: read what the route will do with this picture
steps.expect: the dialog says the picture is kept and the wording carries the look

steps.intent: open the wording prepared for this pass
steps.expect: the finish, the keep clause and the source description are shown before preparing

steps.intent: prepare it in Create
steps.expect: Create opens with the picture attached as the picture to restyle

steps.intent: read the source panel
steps.expect: the continuation names the source; nothing is missing (a board recipe would list its empty slot here)

steps.intent: read the prepared wording
steps.expect: the prompt holds the finish, the keep clause and the source description, ready to edit

steps.intent: read the run control
steps.expect: the run control is enabled and nothing has been submitted

cases.goal: Take a character I like and draw it in the pose of another picture from my library, without knowing which recipe does that (the owner's 14 September 2026 attempt typed 'the pose of the second image' into a one-picture recipe and got the same picture back).
cases.success_condition: The character is attached as the picture to keep (image 1), the pose picture sits on Picture 1 of the board, the prepared wording names the subject and the pose, and the run control reports ready while zero generation requests have been sent.

steps.intent: continue with a recent output from the runs list
steps.expect: a dialog asks where the picture should go next

steps.intent: choose the route that combines two pictures
steps.expect: the Combine route is selected and lists the Klein board recipe

steps.intent: read what the route will do with this picture
steps.expect: the dialog says the character is kept and the pose comes from the picture put on Picture 1

steps.intent: open the wording prepared for this pass
steps.expect: the wording names image 1 and image 2 and carries bracketed fills: who the character is, the pose, and (on the 9B recipe) the clothes and colours

steps.intent: prepare it in Create
steps.expect: Create opens with the picture attached as the picture to keep

steps.intent: read what is still missing
steps.expect: the blockers name Picture 1 (the pose picture) and the bracketed fills, nothing else

steps.intent: add the pose picture to Picture 1
steps.expect: a saved picture fills Picture 1

steps.intent: fill in the wording
steps.expect: replacing every bracketed fill clears the wording blocker

steps.intent: read the run control
steps.expect: the run control is enabled and nothing has been submitted

cases.goal: Try the same character and pose on another Combine engine, compare their seeds and prepare the next attempt without rebuilding the source pair.
cases.success_condition: Switching recipes takes one click, keeps the source roles and three facts, retains edited wording per recipe, shows only matching results, saves independent review decisions and stages same or new seeds without submitting a generation.

steps.intent: continue a saved character through Combine
steps.expect: the source-bound workbench opens

steps.intent: choose a pose picture and describe the result
steps.expect: both source images and the named answers are retained

steps.intent: read the runs for these pictures
steps.expect: unrelated results and collapsed historical problems do not obscure the pair

steps.intent: edit the prepared wording
steps.expect: the edit belongs to this recipe

steps.intent: switch to another engine on the same screen
steps.expect: one click keeps the inputs and answers and updates their image order

steps.intent: return to the previous engine
steps.expect: its edited wording is restored

steps.intent: mark one seed as a keeper and another as needing work
steps.expect: each decision is saved through the existing library

steps.intent: prepare the same seed and then a new seed
steps.expect: the recorded recipe and source pair are loaded without generating

steps.intent: read the run control
steps.expect: the next generation still needs an explicit click

cases.goal: Draw the pose skeleton the Combine recipe needs on the page itself, correct one joint by hand, and put the drawing on Picture 1 without leaving the workbench.
cases.success_condition: The pose panel appears for a Combine, a starting figure loads, one joint moves with the keyboard and can be left out of the guide, and Use this pose attaches the drawing to Picture 1 with the character and the recipe kept and no generation requested.

steps.intent: continue a saved character through Combine
steps.expect: the source-bound workbench opens

steps.intent: choose the route that combines two pictures
steps.expect: the combine recipes are offered

steps.intent: choose the recipe that takes a drawn pose
steps.expect: the prepared wording names the drawn skeleton as image 1

steps.intent: prepare it in Create
steps.expect: the character is attached and nothing runs

steps.intent: find where the pose is drawn
steps.expect: a drawing panel sits beside the two pictures

steps.intent: start from a figure close to the pose wanted
steps.expect: a full skeleton appears, still editable

steps.intent: pick one joint to correct
steps.expect: the picked joint is named and highlighted

steps.intent: move it with the arrow keys
steps.expect: the drawing follows the keyboard

steps.intent: leave one joint out of the guide
steps.expect: it is omitted, with the limbs that touch it

steps.intent: use this drawing as the pose
steps.expect: it is rendered and attached to Picture 1

steps.intent: see what reached Picture 1
steps.expect: the drawing is attached and only the drawing route was called

steps.intent: check that nothing ran
steps.expect: generation is still a separate, explicit press
